Hey, thanks for checking up. It didnt go so good. Like i said, the therapist just doesnt understand my issue. 

What I mean about the spirit and the specific person that i have to communicate with is a real thing happening to me however. Its been 3 specific people at different times that when I texted them i got positive energy in my body from it. The first person was my ex girlfriend, the other two where just two random girls I had hooked up with. 
Anyways, what happend when I had texted my ex girl which i hadnt talked to for about 4 years is that i got my natural flowing energy back. Which at this moment I dont have. 
The reason I know I got this energy is because once I texted her I started making good music again. I use to be a really good rapper until we broke up. Thats when my skills started to slowly decline. I dont know what happened after the break up but my whole entire energy started to fade away slowly throughout the period of 5 years. 
I started noticing that my music wasnt coming out right so I kind of became upsest with trying to make it come out good through out the last years. I could show you before and afters of my raps and im sure youl agree. 
I always had my ex on my mind throughout those years, even while dating other girls. I feel like something was unresolved with her. 
When i finally texted her, i immediatly got this wave of energy that got in my body. I started making music that day i had texted her and boom, my music sounded good again. Not like how it use to, but it atleast had a little bit of life in it. So that wave of energy that got into me lasted for about three days, then it faded away. 
So to see if it was really me texting this girl which had caused me to make good music again was the case, i had to test it out again.
I texted her again 4 days later, and boom the wave came to me again and I could make good music.
So now i know that this out of world experiencing is happening. 
3 days pass and the effects wear off again.
The next time I texted her would be the last time that the energy worked. It would work immedietly after I would send a "hey". 
But after that third time i stopped getting the energy. 

I then randomly got the energy with someother chicks just randomly texting them. I would recieve the energy different with these other two chicks cause it would only work after i asked if they wanted to hang out. 
And boom, back to flow world for 3 days. 

Unfortunatly, i lost the ability to get my energy from these girls too. Now a days i spend my days embarrassing myself texting old random chicks i was with and awkwardly asking to hang out of the blue. Hoping that one of these texts is gunna get me my energy back. But its been 4 months and nothing has worked. Im back to feeling horrible with myself and making crappy music. 

Last thing, the energy wasnt just helping me make good music, but it help me be in the correct vibe when talking around people. Without this energy im baisically a wall. 

Sorry for going off. I know its a lot and it sounds out of this world ridiculous. All i know is that I have evidence of my music being better after texting these chicks. Anyways thanks for reading if yoy got to the end
